# `AviRecord`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Video recording progress (AVI/MP4, optionally timelapse).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, PrintAviRecordState @0x2f4860, PrintMP4RecordState @0x2f4fb0, WriteAviImgData @0x2ed100 (64-bit build); function-state sender SendFuncEvent; thread wrapper terminal mapping (run flag cleared → cancel, code 0 → complete, else fail) after CloseAviFile; plain thread start on one timelapse branch (finding #360) |

Function producer: the recording workers' named function uses the AVI or MP4 formatter. Function-state family: state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. Direct producers: a start event with fps (value family), working events with write_file_fps from the write loop, and fail with code 218 on file-creation failure (state family; code/error only when > 0). Statistics follow writer updates; no guaranteed FPS interval. After stop_record_avi the event ends in `cancel` (no code or error) once the file has been closed; `complete` or `fail` occur only when recording ends by itself. One timelapse start path starts its thread without the wrapper and sends no terminal event (READ); that this holds for all start paths is INFERRED. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. APK consumer expectation, not a firmware field: start_epoch_sec.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. The worker writes the video file.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AviRecord"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function producer: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Direct producers: start (with fps), working (with write_file_fps) and fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Function producer: at fail even if 0. Direct fail: 218 when the AVI file cannot be created (state family: only when code > 0). [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `saved_frames` | integer | if function producer formatter | - | Frames written. [READ] |
| `raw` | boolean | if function producer formatter | - | Raw recording mode; the AVI formatter writes a literal true. [READ] |
| `file_saved` | boolean | if function producer formatter (conditional output) | - | Valid recording output saved: duration > 0.01, a valid internal file handle and status not 284. [READ] |
| `duration_sec` | number | if valid saved output with duration > 0.01 | - | Saved duration; seconds INFERRED. [READ] |
| `name` | string | if valid saved output and the relative path lookup succeeds | - | Relative output name. [READ] |
| `note` | string | if MP4 recording formatter | - | MP4 formatter literal. One of: `mp4 record`. [READ] |
| `timelapse` | object | if timelapse formatter path; normal-versus-timelapse callback selection unresolved | - | Timelapse settings of the recording. [READ] |
| `timelapse.enable` | boolean | no | - | Timelapse flag; forced true in the inspected AVI formatter call. [READ] |
| `timelapse.delay_sec` | number | no | - | Delay between frames, seconds. [READ] |
| `timelapse.src_dura_min` | integer | no | - | Configured source duration, minutes, unscaled. [READ] |
| `fps` | number | if direct start event | - | Frames per second at start (INFERRED unit). [READ] |
| `write_file_fps` | number | if direct write-loop event | - | Write-loop frames per second (INFERRED unit). [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, start - Direct start (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AviRecord","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start","fps":25.0}
```

Event, complete - Recording saved (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AviRecord","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":60000,"saved_frames":1500,"raw":true,"file_saved":true,"duration_sec":60.0,"name":"Video/Example.avi","timelapse":{"enable":true,"delay_sec":2.0,"src_dura_min":30}}
```

Event, cancel - Ended by stop_record_avi (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AviRecord","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"cancel","lapse_ms":42000}
```

Event, create-fail - Direct fail (READ code; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AviRecord","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","code":218,"error":"create file failed"}
```
